optimizedDescription.value: Inspect self-healed spec metadata plus materialization diagnostics and fresh lock-owned optimizations.

optimizedContext.value:
# Spec Metadata

## Rules

- Signature: `specd spec metadata <workspace:capability-path> [--format text|json|toon]`; fully-qualified spec ID required (for example, `default:auth/login`); format defaults `text`. Missing ID: exit 1, usage error on stderr.
- Call `GetSpecMetadata` only; never call `SpecRepository.metadata()` or compute/compare per-file hashes. Use case materializes `if-needed`: reuse fresh persisted projection; regenerate missing, invalid, or stale projection from current artifacts.
- Render returned `metadata`, `source` (`persisted`|`generated`), `regenerated`, and `warnings`. Absent/stale metadata self-heals; not "no metadata exists" error.
- `text`: print spec, title, description, `generatedBy`, source, regenerated; optional non-empty `dependsOn`; counts for rules/constraints/scenarios; `warnings:` only when non-empty, one warning per line; omit other empty sections. `generatedBy`: `core` for deterministic extraction, `agent` for fresh lock-owned optimized field.
- `json`/`toon`: encode full metadata plus diagnostics; rules/constraints/scenarios remain full arrays, not counts. No top-level `fresh` or per-file `contentHashes` array.
- Unconfigured workspace or failure to produce valid metadata (missing spec, schema lacking extraction rules): propagate through `handleError`, print `error:` to stderr, exit 1.

## Constraints

- Caller-facing read-only: accepts no metadata content; exposes no editing.
- `GetSpecMetadata` may cache freshly generated projection. Command never forces rebuild; forced rebuild is `specd spec generate-metadata`.
